articles.title: France's parliament approves vote to hit stablecoin trades with 31% capital gains tax
articles.snippet: Amendment I-3898 removes tax deferral for MiCA-compliant stablecoins starting January 2027.

articles.title: JPMorgan sees 10% annual bitcoin returns, topping stocks, bonds and gold over next decade
articles.snippet: The report marks the first time JPMorgan has put a range on bitcoin returns in its research, though the bank remains cautious about BTC's role in portfolios.

articles.title: Bitcoin drops to $81,400 as Asian chip stocks tumble, options traders seek downside protection
articles.snippet: Bitcoin slipped 0.5% to around $81,400 even after the biggest daily spot ETF inflow in nearly a month as South Korea's Kospi index fell 3.7% on AI worries.

articles.title: Crypto vault deposits top $10 billion as lending risks draw regulatory scrutiny
articles.snippet: Curator-managed lending strategies are attracting institutional capital, while exposing depositors to collateral, liquidity and smart-contract risks.

articles.title: Stablecoin transfers quadruple to $891B as US banks expand adoption: Report
articles.snippet: Coinbase reports growing adoption by banks and businesses, even as stablecoin market capitalization remains largely unchanged over the past year.
